panels.description: Average values from Front and Back clusters

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_f AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id) s.name AS sensor_name, m.value, m.time FROM measurement m JOIN sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.sensor_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%_f' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_%' AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.sensor_id, m.time DESC), latest_b AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id) s.name AS sensor_name, m.value, m.time FROM measurement m JOIN sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.sensor_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%_b' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_%' AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.sensor_id, m.time DESC), sensor_data AS (SELECT CASE WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'dry_bulb' THEN 'Dry Bulb Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'wet_bulb' THEN 'Wet Bulb Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'rh' THEN 'RH Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'vpd' THEN 'VPD Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'co2' THEN 'CO2 Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'pressure' THEN 'Pressure Avg' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'water_level' THEN 'Water Level Avg' ELSE REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') || ' Avg' END AS "Sensor", ROUND((f.value + b.value) / 2.0, 2) AS value_num, CASE WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'dry_bulb' THEN '°C' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'wet_bulb' THEN '°C' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'rh' THEN '%' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'vpd' THEN ' kPa' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'co2' THEN ' ppm' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'pressure' THEN ' hPa' WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'water_level' THEN ' mm' ELSE '' END AS unit, GREATEST(f.time, b.time) AS time_val, CASE WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'dry_bulb' THEN 1 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'wet_bulb' THEN 2 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'rh' THEN 3 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'vpd' THEN 4 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'co2' THEN 5 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'pressure' THEN 6 WHEN REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = 'water_level' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END AS sort_order FROM latest_f f JOIN latest_b b ON REPLACE(f.sensor_name, '_f', '') = REPLACE(b.sensor_name, '_b', '')), combined AS (SELECT "Sensor", (value_num::text || unit) AS "Value", sort_order FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT 'Last Update' AS "Sensor", TO_CHAR(MAX(time_val), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Value", 999 AS sort_order FROM sensor_data) SELECT "Sensor", "Value" FROM combined ORDER BY sort_order, "Sensor"

panels.title: Averages

targets.rawSql:
WITH span AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch from ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS sec
),
bwin AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sec <= 3600    THEN INTERVAL '1 second'
              WHEN sec <= 21600   THEN INTERVAL '30 seconds'
              WHEN sec <= 86400   THEN INTERVAL '1 minute'
              WHEN sec <= 172800  THEN INTERVAL '5 minutes'
              ELSE                     INTERVAL '1 hour' END AS iv
  FROM span
)
SELECT
  time_bucket((SELECT iv FROM bwin), time) AS "time",
  sensor_name AS metric,
  avg(value) AS value
FROM measurement_with_metadata
WHERE sensor_name IN ('dry_bulb_f', 'wet_bulb_f', 'rh_f', 'vpd_f', 'dry_bulb_b', 'wet_bulb_b', 'rh_b', 'vpd_b')
  AND time >= $__timeFrom()
  AND time <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  'Heating Setpoint - Main' AS metric,
  effective_heating_setpoint AS value
FROM effective_setpoints
WHERE location = 'Flower Room'
  AND cluster = 'main'
  AND effective_heating_setpoint IS NOT NULL
  AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom()
  AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY timestamp

WITH time_points AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz + INTERVAL '1 minute',
    INTERVAL '1 minute'
  ) AS utc_time
),
local_points AS (
  SELECT
    utc_time,
    timezone('America/Toronto', utc_time) AS local_time
  FROM time_points
),
room_schedule AS (
  SELECT start_time AS day_start_time, end_time AS day_end_time
  FROM schedules
  WHERE location = 'Flower Room' 
    AND cluster = 'main'
    AND device_name = 'room_schedule'
    AND enabled = true
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  lp.utc_time AS "time",
  'DAY Period Overlay' AS metric,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_schedule)
      AND (
        SELECT CASE 
          WHEN (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) <= (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
            THEN lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
                 AND lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
          ELSE lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
               OR lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
        END
      )
    THEN 100.0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS value
FROM local_points lp

WITH time_points AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz + INTERVAL '1 minute',
    INTERVAL '1 minute'
  ) AS utc_time
),
local_points AS (
  SELECT
    utc_time,
    timezone('America/Toronto', utc_time) AS local_time
  FROM time_points
),
room_schedule AS (
  SELECT start_time AS day_start_time, end_time AS day_end_time
  FROM schedules
  WHERE location = 'Flower Room' 
    AND cluster = 'main'
    AND device_name = 'room_schedule'
    AND enabled = true
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  lp.utc_time AS "time",
  'NIGHT Period Overlay' AS metric,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_schedule)
      AND NOT (
        SELECT CASE 
          WHEN (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) <= (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
            THEN lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
                 AND lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
          ELSE lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
               OR lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
        END
      )
    THEN 100.0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS value
FROM local_points lp

WITH sensor_data AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id) CASE s.name WHEN 'dry_bulb_f' THEN 'Dry Bulb' WHEN 'wet_bulb_f' THEN 'Wet Bulb' WHEN 'rh_f' THEN 'RH' WHEN 'vpd_f' THEN 'VPD' WHEN 'co2_f' THEN 'CO2' WHEN 'pressure_f' THEN 'Pressure' WHEN 'secondary_temp_f' THEN 'Secondary Temp' WHEN 'secondary_rh_f' THEN 'Secondary RH' WHEN 'water_level_f' THEN 'Water Level' ELSE s.name END AS "Sensor", m.value AS value_num, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' OR s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN ' kPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN ' ppm' WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN ' hPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN ' mm' ELSE '' END AS unit, m.time AS time_val, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' THEN 1 WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN 2 WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 3 WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN 4 WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN 5 WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN 6 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN 7 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 8 WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END AS sort_order FROM measurement m JOIN sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.sensor_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%_f' AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.sensor_id, m.time DESC), combined AS (SELECT "Sensor", (value_num::text || unit) AS "Value", sort_order FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT 'Last Update' AS "Sensor", TO_CHAR(MAX(time_val), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Value", 999 AS sort_order FROM sensor_data) SELECT "Sensor", "Value" FROM combined ORDER BY sort_order, "Sensor"

WITH sensor_data AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id) CASE s.name WHEN 'dry_bulb_b' THEN 'Dry Bulb' WHEN 'wet_bulb_b' THEN 'Wet Bulb' WHEN 'rh_b' THEN 'RH' WHEN 'vpd_b' THEN 'VPD' WHEN 'co2_b' THEN 'CO2' WHEN 'pressure_b' THEN 'Pressure' WHEN 'secondary_temp_b' THEN 'Secondary Temp' WHEN 'secondary_rh_b' THEN 'Secondary RH' WHEN 'water_level_b' THEN 'Water Level' ELSE s.name END AS "Sensor", m.value AS value_num, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' OR s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN ' kPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN ' ppm' WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN ' hPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN ' mm' ELSE '' END AS unit, m.time AS time_val, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' THEN 1 WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN 2 WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 3 WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN 4 WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN 5 WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN 6 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN 7 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 8 WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END AS sort_order FROM measurement m JOIN sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.sensor_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%_b' AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.sensor_id, m.time DESC), combined AS (SELECT "Sensor", (value_num::text || unit) AS "Value", sort_order FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT 'Last Update' AS "Sensor", TO_CHAR(MAX(time_val), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Value", 999 AS sort_order FROM sensor_data) SELECT "Sensor", "Value" FROM combined ORDER BY sort_order, "Sensor"

WITH span AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch from ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS sec
),
bwin AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN sec <= 3600    THEN INTERVAL '1 second'
              WHEN sec <= 21600   THEN INTERVAL '30 seconds'
              WHEN sec <= 86400   THEN INTERVAL '1 minute'
              WHEN sec <= 172800  THEN INTERVAL '5 minutes'
              ELSE                     INTERVAL '1 hour' END AS iv
  FROM span
)
SELECT
  time_bucket((SELECT iv FROM bwin), time) AS "time",
  sensor_name AS metric,
  avg(value) AS value
FROM measurement_with_metadata
WHERE (sensor_name LIKE 'co2_%' OR sensor_name = 'pressure_b')
  AND time >= $__timeFrom()
  AND time <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT timestamp AS "time", device_name || ' - State' AS metric, device_state * 100 AS value FROM automation_state WHERE location = 'Flower Room' AND cluster = 'main' AND device_name = 'exhaust_fan' AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS "time", device_name || ' - State' AS metric, device_state * 100 AS value FROM automation_state WHERE location = 'Flower Room' AND cluster = 'main' AND device_name = 'Midea Cube 50 pints' AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS "time", device_name || ' - State' AS metric, device_state * 100 AS value FROM automation_state WHERE location = 'Flower Room' AND cluster = 'main' AND device_name = 'Heater Flower' AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS "time", device_name || ' - PID Output' AS metric, COALESCE(pid_output, 0) AS value FROM automation_state WHERE location = 'Flower Room' AND cluster = 'main' AND device_name = 'Heater Flower' AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND timestamp <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY timestamp

WITH light_data AS (
  SELECT timestamp, effective_light_intensity
  FROM effective_setpoints
  WHERE location = 'Flower Room' 
    AND cluster = 'main' 
    AND device_name = 'light_1'
    AND effective_light_intensity IS NOT NULL
    AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom()
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()
),
last_value AS (
  SELECT effective_light_intensity, timestamp
  FROM light_data
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT timestamp AS "time", 'light_1 - Intensity' AS metric, effective_light_intensity AS value
FROM light_data
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS "time", 'light_1 - Intensity' AS metric, effective_light_intensity AS value
FROM last_value
WHERE effective_light_intensity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT CASE sensor_name WHEN 'dry_bulb_f' THEN 'Dry Bulb (°C) - Front' WHEN 'dry_bulb_b' THEN 'Dry Bulb (°C) - Back' WHEN 'wet_bulb_f' THEN 'Wet Bulb (°C) - Front' WHEN 'wet_bulb_b' THEN 'Wet Bulb (°C) - Back' WHEN 'rh_f' THEN 'RH (%) - Front' WHEN 'rh_b' THEN 'RH (%) - Back' WHEN 'vpd_f' THEN 'VPD (kPa) - Front' WHEN 'vpd_b' THEN 'VPD (kPa) - Back' WHEN 'co2_f' THEN 'CO2 (ppm) - Front' WHEN 'co2_b' THEN 'CO2 (ppm) - Back' WHEN 'pressure_f' THEN 'Pressure (hPa) - Front' WHEN 'pressure_b' THEN 'Pressure (hPa) - Back' WHEN 'secondary_temp_f' THEN 'Secondary Temp (°C) - Front' WHEN 'secondary_temp_b' THEN 'Secondary Temp (°C) - Back' WHEN 'secondary_rh_f' THEN 'Secondary RH (%) - Front' WHEN 'secondary_rh_b' THEN 'Secondary RH (%) - Back' WHEN 'water_level_f' THEN 'Water Level (mm) - Front' WHEN 'water_level_b' THEN 'Water Level (mm) - Back' ELSE sensor_name END AS "Sensor", MIN(value) AS "Min", MAX(value) AS "Max", AVG(value) AS "Average", COALESCE(STDDEV(value), 0) AS "Std Dev" FROM measurement_with_metadata WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY sensor_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' THEN 1 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN 2 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'rh%' AND sensor_name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 3 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN 4 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'co2%' THEN 5 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN 6 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN 7 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 8 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END, sensor_name
